# JobSearch

> **Incomplete core and .NET 10 upgrade assessments.** The tools could not load the legacy web project because `Microsoft.WebApplication.targets` is unavailable in this Linux environment. Zero upgrade findings is not a compatibility result. DataLoader's solution was not assessed for upgrade readiness after this failure. Re-run both solutions on Windows with Visual Studio web build tools and .NET Framework targeting packs.

Security results contain five dependency advisory matches and five conditional/source-pattern CWE findings, not five proven exploits. See the [full security assessment](security/security-assessment.md) for remediation, evidence, and coverage limitations.
